# gitmoap_catalog_service_deployments_current (Data Source)

What a service has deployed right now. The service's current deployment in each environment it has been deployed to. Reporters and above on the service's declaring group may call it; deployments are not public.

The token needs `catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "platform" {
  full_path = "acme/platform"
}

resource "gitmoap_catalog_service" "api" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.platform.group_id
  slug     = "api"
  external = true
}

data "gitmoap_catalog_service_deployments_current" "example" {
  service_id = gitmoap_catalog_service.api.service_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) The service's id

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `commit_sha` (String)
- `deployed_at` (String)
- `deployment_id` (String)
- `environment_id` (String)
- `pipeline_run_id` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `service_id` (String)
- `status` (String) Where a deployment is in its life. It starts `requested`; waits as `awaiting_approval` when the
environment needs approval, ending `rejected` if refused; then `running`, ending `succeeded`,
`failed` or `cancelled`. `skipped` means another deploy held the environment and its policy is to
skip. A successful deployment becomes `superseded` when a later one replaces it.
